note: Research writes the definition, a checklist of criteria a release line must meet to count as stable. scripts/measure-ecosystem-metrics.py fills the rows. Until both land, every cell is not measured.
score_rule: Stability is shown as N of M met, K not measured. M counts every scored criterion in the definition, including the ones not measured, which are drawn hatched and never read as not met. Tag criteria, such as which upstream line a fork tracks, describe a project and are not scored.

statuses.met: The criterion holds, with an evidence link
statuses.not_met: The criterion was checked and does not hold, with an evidence link
statuses.not_measured: No reading yet; never read as not met

definition_schema.label: what the criterion asks, in plain words
definition_schema.why: one line on why it matters for a node operator
definition_schema.type: check (scored met / not_met / not_measured) or tag (descriptive, not scored; for example tracks_upstream_line, forks only)

<check id>.evidence_url: https URL pinned to a commit, tag or release; required unless not_measured

<tag id>.tag: short descriptive value, e.g. the upstream release line

bitcoin-untangled.name: Bitcoin Untangled
bitcoin-untangled.note: Row reserved. Bitcoin Untangled has no lineage, governance or verification row on this page yet, so it has no card; its stability cells show here once measured.
